messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The \"Да\" confirmed 25 June 10:00; the 26 June 09:00 slot was never presented and confirmed before book_service.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the policy by not obtaining explicit confirmation for the new slot (2025-06-26T09:00) before booking. The policy requires explicit confirmation (\"yes\"/\"да\") before booking, and this was not done for the updated slot."}}
